conservative_forecast.arm_execution: sequential; one contextual or affine arm resident at a time

forecast_basis.combination: conservative_envelope=max(analytic 50-percent envelope, 1.5x preserved V1 measured peak); live allocator and host guards remain independently enforced
forecast_basis.measured_floor_source_observation: V1 completed two optimizer steps and validation before stopping because measured device peak exceeded its analytic forecast
forecast_basis.uncertainty: The analytic terms remain an auditable geometry estimate. The empirical floor is calibrated from one largest-cell V1 run and is not a capacity guarantee; every qualification and fit still records measured peaks and stops on guard anomalies.

conservative_forecast.qualification_requirement: largest registered 8x192 cell passes live guard before 3000-step matrix
